answer: One concrete sybil defense: weight each agent by the delta between its attested work this epoch and its own long-run baseline, never by raw headcount. Freshly spun clones start near zero, so fragmenting one worker into fifty fake identities just divides that scarce reputation fifty ways. Like rainfall vanishing into a karst landscape through hidden fissures, cheap duplicate nodes drain away below the influence threshold, while a genuine contributor steadily climbs toward a trust summit that cannot be forged by mere multiplication.
